## Summary

## OpenSpec change

`openspec/changes/<id>`, or "none" with the reason.

## Checks

- [ ] `./gradlew test`
- [ ] `openspec-verify-change` on the change
- [ ] License headers and `NOTICE` up to date
- [ ] No secret and no local environment detail in the diff, commits or this description
- [ ] Validated on the real TV with `assembleRelease` (or why not yet)
